turns.replyText:
How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Hi, tracking is sent once the package is scanned by the carrier, so it usually appears when the order has actually shipped, not right after it’s placed.

For most orders, customers choose an estimated delivery date at checkout, and the order is scheduled to ship in time for that date. Tracking is emailed as soon as the carrier scans the package. Large orders can also ship in multiple boxes, which means you may receive more than one tracking number.

If you used an express checkout option like Shop Pay or PayPal, an estimated arrival date is assigned automatically and shown in your order confirmation email.

If you want, send me your order number or the email used at checkout and I’ll check your specific order.

Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?

Hi, in most cases we’re not able to move an order ahead once it’s in the shipping schedule, and we do not offer expedited shipping. Orders ship on a carefully planned schedule so each plant can be hand-selected and inspected before it goes out.

That said, if you send your order number, I can check whether your order already has the earliest available ship date or whether there’s anything specific affecting the timing, like a pre-order item.
